enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Wake up briefly. Check clock. Close eyes again. Sleep. Shift leg. Scratch arm. Turn over. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with kettle and toaster, then washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, jam. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Open drawer. Take out knife. Open kettle lid. Fill kettle with water. Close lid. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Place on plate. Spread butter. Spread jam. Eat breakfast. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Scrape leftovers into trash. Rinse plate. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and setting up the desk for the work-from-home day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk to desk. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust chair. Sit down. Open computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking email, reviewing the day's program schedule, and planning tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email application. Enter password. Click on inbox. Read emails. Reply to urgent email. Type response. Send email. Open calendar. Review schedule. Open task management app. Create task list. Prioritize tasks. Set reminders. Close email. Open document.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination tasks on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Read document. Highlight text. Copy text. Paste text. Save document. Lean back. Stretch arms. Adjust desk lamp. Continue typing. Check email. Reply to email. Open file. Close file. Stand up. Walk around room. Sit down. Continue typing.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a coffee break and boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open cabinet. Take out mug. Place mug on counter. Open kettle lid. Fill with water. Close lid. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Wait for water to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Add coffee. Stir. Add milk. Stir. Pick up mug. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing program coordination work, drafting reports and replying to partner emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open report template. Type report. Insert table. Format text. Save report. Open email. Read partner email. Draft reply. Attach report. Send email. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send invitation. Close documents. Stretch.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch using the induction cooker and microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Open microwave. Place bowl inside. Close microwave. Set timer. Press start. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out bowl. Place on counter. Pick up plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plate. Rinse. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighborhood to get fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open door. Walk outside. Close door. Walk down street. Turn left. Walk past park. Turn right. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Walk to corner. Turn around. Walk back. Open door. Enter house. Close door. Remove shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Hosting virtual meetings and coordinating volunteer rosters on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open computer. Launch video conferencing app. Join meeting. Adjust camera. Unmute microphone. Speak: 'Hello everyone, let's start.' Listen to participants. Take notes. Share screen. Open roster spreadsheet. Discuss volunteer assignments. Type notes. Mute microphone. End meeting. Close app. Open email. Send roster to team. Close email. Stand up. Stretch.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open cabinet. Take out tea bag. Take out mug. Fill kettle with water. Boil water. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Wait. Remove tea bag. Add sugar. Stir. Open pantry. Take out biscuits. Place biscuits on plate. Pick up mug. Pick up plate. Sit at table. Drink tea. Eat biscuit.

enriched_activities.activity: Finishing administrative work, updating databases, and wrapping up the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open database. Update records. Save database. Open email. Reply to emails. Close email. Open document. Proofread. Edit. Save. Close document. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Push chair in. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up clothes from sofa. Fold clothes. Place in basket. Pick up magazines. Stack magazines. Place on shelf. Pick up trash. Throw in bin. Move cushions. Straighten cushions. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Open microwave. Place bowl. Close. Set timer. Press start. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open. Take out bowl. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plate. Scrape leftovers. Rinse. Open dishwasher. Place plate. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to sofa. Sit down. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Lean back. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Browsing on the phone and reading under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Continue scrolling. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Chatting online and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open chat app. Type message. Send. Receive reply. Read. Type reply. Send. Open music app. Select playlist. Play music. Adjust volume. Put down phone. Listen to music. Pick up phone. Continue chatting. Send emoji.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Wake up briefly. Check clock. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Pull blanket up. Sleep.
